title: FHIRBridge CSV/Excel column mapping
description: Canonical column-mapping format for `fhirbridge import` and POST /api/v1/connectors/import. Each row of the file produces at most one resource per entry in resourceTypes. See examples/README.md for the semantics (valueMap, transforms, literals, timezone). The importer (parseMappingConfig in @fhirbridge/core) additionally checks every path against the FHIR R4 elements it supports and reports precise errors.

patientId.description: Column that identifies the patient on every row. Its value becomes Patient.identifier (with `system`), deduplicates Patients across rows and links the other resources to them.

system.description: Identifier namespace URI, e.g. urn:oid:... or https://...

sheet.description: Excel only. One sheet name for every resource type, or an object naming a sheet for each entry in resourceTypes (the Patient sheet is read first; other sheets link rows to patients through the patientId column). Default: the first sheet.

timezone.description: UTC offset applied to datetime values that carry a time but no offset (FHIR requires one). Without it such values are emitted as dates only.

resourceTypes.description: Resource types produced per row, in output order. Defaults to the types used in `fields`.

fields.description: "<ResourceType>.<path>" → column name, column spec or literal. Repeating elements take [] or [n]; without an index the first item is used ("Patient.name.family" = "Patient.name[0].family").

format.description: Input layout for date/datetime. Tokens: YYYY, MM, DD, HH, mm, ss, Z (UTC offset in the value); everything else is literal, e.g. "DD/MM/YYYY HH:mm".

valueMap.description: Source value → output value; looked up (exact, then case-insensitive) before the transform. Unmapped values pass through.

literal.description: Constant. Emitted only when its element (nearest array item, else the top-level element) also gets a value from a column in that row.
